# relay_private_endpoint_service (Resource)

The workspace's private endpoint service in one cloud region: what a `relay_private_endpoint` and the cloud-side endpoint point at. One per workspace, cloud and region. Destroying it waits for its endpoints to be gone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "relay_private_endpoint_service" "use1" {
  workspace_id = relay_workspace.prod.id
  cloud        = "aws"
  region       = "us-east-1"
}

resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "relay" {
  vpc_id             = aws_vpc.app.id
  service_name       = relay_private_endpoint_service.use1.endpoint_service_name
  vpc_endpoint_type  = "Interface"
  subnet_ids         = aws_subnet.private[*].id
  security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.relay.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider. Only `aws` is served today.
- `region` (String) Cloud region, for example `us-east-1`. Must be one the platform serves private endpoints in.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace the service belongs to.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `endpoint_service_name` (String) AWS VPC endpoint service name (`com.amazonaws.vpce.<region>.vpce-svc-…`), the `service_name` of an `aws_vpc_endpoint`.
- `error_message` (String) Why the service failed, when it did.
- `id` (String) Service ID.
- `status` (String) `INITIATING`, `AVAILABLE`, `FAILED` or `DELETING`.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import relay_private_endpoint_service.use1 <workspace_id>/<cloud>/<region>
terraform import relay_private_endpoint_service.use1 <workspace_id>/<service_id>
```
